name: Citizen Service Request Processing
description: Receives citizen service requests via a public-facing webhook, validates the submission data, uses AI to classify the request type and route it to the appropriate department, stores the ticket in the case management database, and sends parallel notifications to both the citizen (confirmation) and the assigned department (new case alert). Streamlines municipal service delivery for government agencies.

data.label: Receive citizen service request from portal

config.errorMessage: Please provide all required fields with valid data.

data.label: Classify request and determine department routing

config.prompt:
You are a municipal service request classifier for a city government. Analyze the following citizen service request and classify it.

Request:
Category Selected: {{category}}
Description: {{description}}
Location: {{location}}

Classify into exactly ONE department:
- PUBLIC_WORKS: roads, sidewalks, streetlights, water, sewage
- PARKS_AND_REC: parks, playgrounds, trails, community centers
- SANITATION: garbage, recycling, illegal dumping, street cleaning
- CODE_ENFORCEMENT: building violations, zoning, noise complaints
- PUBLIC_SAFETY: traffic hazards, damaged signs, emergency prep
- UTILITIES: power outages, water quality, gas leaks
- GENERAL: anything that doesn't fit above categories

Also determine:
- Priority: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT
- Estimated resolution time in business days
- A brief summary (1 sentence) for the case title

Return JSON: { department, priority, estimatedDays, caseTitle }

data.label: Route to department based on AI classification
Create service case in case management system

config.query: INSERT INTO service_cases (case_number, citizen_name, citizen_email, category, department, priority, description, location, case_title, estimated_resolution_days, status, created_at) VALUES (CONCAT('SR-', TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD'), '-', LPAD(nextval('case_seq')::text, 4, '0')), '{{citizenName}}', '{{email}}', '{{category}}', '{{department}}', '{{priority}}', '{{description}}', '{{location}}', '{{caseTitle}}', {{estimatedDays}}, 'open', NOW()) RETURNING case_number, id

config.subject: Service Request Received - {{caseNumber}}

data.label: Alert assigned department of new case
Log case creation for audit trail

config.message: Case {{caseNumber}} created. Department: {{department}}. Priority: {{priority}}. Citizen notified: true. Department notified: true.
